description: Public descriptions of the MCP tools and their parameters, from the API docs and the integration rules. A null default means the parameter is sent only when set, so the API default applies.

url.name: url
url.description: URL of the page to scrape. Must include the protocol (https://).

browserRendering.name: browserRendering
browserRendering.description: Controls whether the page is loaded in a browser. Leave it out to load the page without a browser first and switch to a browser automatically if the request is blocked. Set true to always load the page in a browser, which JavaScript-heavy sites, SPAs, and pages that load content dynamically need. Set false to never use a browser.

timeout.name: timeout
timeout.description: Maximum seconds to wait for the scrape before the request times out, from 1 to 330. Increase for slow or complex pages. Defaults to 300.

warmStart.name: warmStart
warmStart.description: Opens the site's home page first to warm the session before loading the target URL. Useful for sites that expect a normal browsing session before deeper pages.

blockResources.name: blockResources
blockResources.description: Blocks images, fonts, and stylesheets from loading. Speeds up scraping and reduces bandwidth usage.

waitForSelector.name: waitForSelector
waitForSelector.description: Waits until a specific CSS selector or text appears on the page before returning it, such as #results. Up to 500 characters. Useful for content that loads asynchronously after the initial page load.

geoCode.name: geoCode
geoCode.description: Two-letter country code to load the page from, such as us or gb. Defaults to the United States.

maxAge.name: maxAge
maxAge.description: Serves a cached result of the same request when it is newer than this age, in milliseconds, such as 86400000 for 1 day. Up to 604800000 (7 days). 0, the default, always scrapes fresh. A cached result costs the same tokens as the original scrape.

maxRetries.name: maxRetries
maxRetries.description: Maximum number of retries for the request. Omit for no limit.

htmlScreenshot.name: screenshot
htmlScreenshot.description: Also captures a screenshot of the rendered page as a base64-encoded PNG: full captures the entire scroll height, top captures the first viewport, and <width>x<height> sets the viewport size in pixels with an optional -<zoom> percent, such as 1280x800 or 1920x1080-75. Width and height range from 100 to 3840, zoom from 25 to 300. Setting it forces browser rendering. Leave it out for no screenshot.

screenshotArea.name: screenshot
screenshotArea.description: Screenshot area: full captures the entire scroll height (the default), top captures the first viewport, and <width>x<height> sets the viewport size in pixels with an optional -<zoom> percent, such as 1280x800 or 1920x1080-75. Width and height range from 100 to 3840, zoom from 25 to 300. The image is a base64-encoded PNG.

includeScreenshot.name: screenshot
includeScreenshot.description: Captures a screenshot of the rendered page as a base64-encoded image. Useful for verifying what the scraper actually saw. Off by default.

html.name: html
html.description: Returns the raw HTML of the scraped page in the response. On by default; set false to leave it out.

prompt.name: prompt
prompt.description: Description of the data shape you want back, for example fields like title, price, and rating. The prompt only parses the scraped content; it cannot instruct the scraper itself. To shape the output with a JSON schema, append it to the prompt as a Json Schema: section. Defaults to "Extract all data as complete as possible."

query.name: query
query.description: The search query, from 1 to 1000 characters.

country.name: country
country.description: Two-letter country code to run the search from. Defaults to the United States.

numResults.name: numResults
numResults.description: How many results to return, from 10 to 100. The search may return fewer. Defaults to 10.

token.name: token
token.description: API key used to authenticate the request.

services.name: status
services.title: Status
services.description: Return the raw account status API response without summarizing, redacting body fields, or adding calculated fields.
services.response: The API body contains message and data. Account details remain nested in data, including subscriptionItem and scraperAllowance. The response envelope therefore exposes account details at data.data. Sensitive response headers are removed.

services.name: scrape-html
services.title: Scrape HTML
services.description: Retrieve the raw HTML of a page. Browser rendering and a screenshot are optional.
services.response: The default response body is HTML text. Setting screenshot can make the API return JSON with the HTML and the base64 screenshot; the returned structure is preserved.

services.name: scrape-markdown
services.title: Scrape Markdown
services.description: Retrieve a page as Markdown. Browser rendering is optional.
services.response: The response body is Markdown text.

services.name: get-screenshot
services.title: Get screenshot
services.description: Capture a base64 PNG screenshot of the full page, the top viewport, or a custom viewport size. Browser rendering is always enabled.
services.response: The response body contains the base64 screenshot. The API can still include an html field, empty or not, although HTML output is off.

services.name: scrape-brand
services.title: Scrape brand
services.description: Extract a website's colors, typography, logos, and social links as JSON.
services.response: The API body contains message and a data object with job_id, status, url, final_url, brand, and error. Brand details are available at data.data.brand in the response envelope.

services.name: scrape-json
services.title: Scrape JSON
services.description: Extract structured JSON from a page using a natural-language prompt. Append Json Schema: and a JSON schema to shape the output.
services.response: Extraction results are in the API body's data field and follow the requested schema. Response metadata includes thread_id, token_usage, status, error, runtime, and cookies. html is included by default; markdown, and screenshot unless requested, can be empty strings.

services.name: web-search
services.title: Web search
services.description: Search the web and return ranked results with titles, URLs, descriptions, and sources.
services.response: The API body contains success, message, a data array, and tokenUsage. Each result includes rank, title, url, description, and source.

response_examples_note: Response examples show selected keys and types observed in live API responses. Values are placeholders; page content, base64 images, and arrays are abbreviated. Actual responses may contain additional fields.
